content: Thank you very much for the feedback on what to change.
It seems to me like it would be a slight challenge to try to figure out the pattern to code based on tests provided. but I changed it.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format the statement properly by following the example there:

[[ ]] for variables (begin, n, k, r)
{{ }} for constants (1)
<< >> for bold (Line 1, Line 2, Line 3, Line 4)

General
* The Goal and Output sections specify that the output consists of one line only: the final value of [[begin]]. This is inconsistent with your solution and the expected output of the cases.

Constraints / Cases
* begin, n and k are never negative in the current cases. Please change -100 to 0, or modify the cases to cover the full range of possible values in a balanced manner.

* Similarly, n and k never exceed 10 in the current cases. Adjust the bound or modify the cases accordingly.

* Please increase the lower bound of r to 1.

* In general, please use a greater variety of input values. For example, r = 4 in half of the existing cases. That should be changed.

Stub generator
* Please change "beginn" to "begin".

Game modes
* It seems impossible to infer the task from visible cases only in Reverse mode. Consider disabling that mode.

Thanks.
